text:
Eli: Heads up — PR #6321 patches a tokenization CVE and needs 2x LGTM before the 45m cutoff for this hotfix window. Tests are green on unit CI but we saw an intermittent integration failure in staging. @Sam @Aisha can you take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6321 :pray:
Sam: On it, starting a quick security + perf pass. If it's just the one line change we can probably merge fast but policy still requires two approvals.
Aisha: I'll check the security diffs and e2e implications. pinging sec-team for a quick signoff.
deploy-bot: ci/unit ✅, ci/integration flaky (1/3) — rerun queued.
Jun: Quick question about this snippet — is the fallback intended to be stringify(true) or should it be boolean?
Jun: ```js
// in tokenizer.js
opts.allowUnsafeFallback = process.env.ALLOW_FALLBACK || "true"
```
Aisha: Good catch, Jun — that should be a boolean. small fix, low risk. I'll add a note in the review.
Maya: For rollout, propose a canary: 10% traffic for 30m then cutover if no regressions. keeps blast radius small.
Sam: Review notes: left 2 tiny nits + one race-condition question around cache invalidation. If Jun's boolean fix and the cache lock are addressed, I can give +1.
Eli: We're cutting close on the window — if we get 2x LGTM in ~30m we can make it. Otherwise we'll use rollback policy for any late merge.
Aisha: Security team responded — no new perms, no data exposure. I'm +1 assuming Jun flips that string to a boolean.
Sam: Made the cache-lock suggestion inline, pushed a follow-up commit suggestion. After that I'm happy to approve.
Eli: Thanks. Once Sam approves I'll merge and trigger canary per Maya's plan.
Maya: :thumbsup: I'll monitor canary metrics (latency/error) and call abort if anything spikes.
deploy-bot: merge-gate open until 2178505400 (45m after thread start).
Sam: Approved after addressing nits. +1 from me.
Aisha: +1 (security ok). Go ahead to merge when you're ready @Eli.
Eli: Merged and kicked off canary. Watching dashboards now.
Maya: Canary looks clean at 10m — no regressions so far.
Eli: Thanks everyone, closing the loop.
